meta.method: Each CHFA Applicant Report (and the rolling federal 4% and MIHTC lists) is read as a table; a report whose rows do not add up to the TOTALS row it prints contributes none. Contact names, emails and phones are not read. Outcomes are derived: a project counts as awarded when the same name and city is on a CHFA award report in data/policy/funding-awards/ledger.json for the same credit within two years; not_awarded only when that round's award report is published and the project is on none. CHFA prints neither 'not awarded' nor 'withdrawn'.
meta.amount_note: Credit amounts are the ANNUAL amounts requested, as CHFA prints them.
